_parts._note: MG42: no skeleton places its bipod ('stand'); it is stored upright (legs up) at its pivot under the muzzle. In-game (IMFDB screenshots) it hangs below the barrel, so it is turned 180 degrees about the barrel axis - an editorial fix. The no-bipod model still carries the stand; it is left out. The .30 cal turret model stores its bipod the same way (legs up, 33 cm above the barrel) and gets the same turn.

_assemblies._note: Vehicle guns and their stands are separate models the game joins at the vehicle's tags. Offsets are the tag distances in catalog metres (x, up, -y of COD): SAS Jeep tag_gunner_turret -> tag_gunner_barrel 1.212 m up (the 1.27 m pedestal), tag_turret -> tag_barrel 0.208 m up (the 22 cm mount); Horch tag_gunner_turret -> tag_gunner_barrel (0.039, 1.466, -0.010) (the 1.45 m pole).
